selection_rule: All nine fixtures in the user-provided image, the Wednesday half of Champions League Matchday 4; Tuesday's nine matches are outside this requested cohort.
target_result_exposure: Results were visible in the supplied image and some verification search snippets. This is not a blind test. Subsequent feature collection filters target scores/status/incidents, and the deterministic rule will not be tuned to these results.
history_selection: Five latest completed competitive matches in all competitions before the common cutoff; no target fixture can enter the history. Keep normal-time draws as draws even when a shootout/extra time decided the tie.
coverage_policy: Missing features remain null. No fabricated xG, injury counts or market quotes. No numerical prediction for a team with fewer than five verified 90m histories.

predeclared_pattern_flags.both_scored_ge4of5: both teams scored in at least four of their last five matches
predeclared_pattern_flags.both_conceded_ge4of5: both teams conceded in at least four of their last five matches
predeclared_pattern_flags.both_low_clean_sheet: each team kept at most one clean sheet in its last five matches
predeclared_pattern_flags.one_high_clean_sheet: at least one team kept three or more clean sheets in its last five matches
predeclared_pattern_flags.both_historical_btts_majority: BTTS occurred in at least three of the last five matches for each team
predeclared_pattern_flags.away_model_favourite: away 1X2 probability is the largest of the three outcomes
predeclared_pattern_flags.both_shots_12_to_15: each team's mean total shots is 12 to 15 inclusive, only when all five games have comparable data; otherwise null

pattern_policy: Flags are descriptive candidate hypotheses; no fitted coefficients or causality claims. Report all cohort games, misses and unavailable flags. Do not optimize thresholds after grading.
notes: The baseline is intentionally the same goal-only rule used for the earlier case; here its lack of venue/opponent adjustment remains a limitation.
Historical pages are retrieved now, not archived snapshots guaranteed to be identical at cutoff.
The sample is a single selected session with nine correlated games, not an independent season-long validation.
Pre-match team news, H2H and xG are researched as context; their incremental predictive value is not tested by this baseline.
